exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Planning a Trip
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: We only have one day in the city. Which attraction should we see first?

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: The old harbour bridge, I think. It was built almost a hundred years ago.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: That sounds great. Is it far from our hotel?

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: No, it's quite close. We can walk there in about twenty minutes.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: Perfect. And after the bridge, where do you want to go?

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: Let's visit the museum located by the river. It used to be an old prison.

transcript.speaker: Mia
transcript.text: An old prison? That will be really interesting!

transcript.speaker: Leo
transcript.text: Yes. Then in the evening we can watch the sunset from the lookout.

exercises.translation_cn: Mia 和 Leo 只有一天时间逛城市;Leo 建议先看近百年历史的旧海港大桥,离酒店步行约20分钟;之后去河边那座由旧监狱改成的博物馆;傍晚再去瞭望台看日落。

questions.stem: Which attraction does Leo want to see first?
How long does it take to walk to the bridge?
What was the river museum in the past?
What will they do in the evening?
options: Watch the sunset from the lookout.

questions.stem: How does Mia feel about the museum plan?
options: She does not want to go.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Amazing New Zealand
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: New Zealand is a country located far to the south of the equator.
It is famous for its green hills, clear lakes and geothermal parks.
In some areas, hot water shoots high into the air from the ground.
The country is also home to the kiwi, a small bird that cannot fly.
For nature lovers, New Zealand is one of the most beautiful getaways on Earth.
exercises.translation_cn: 新西兰位于赤道以南很远的地方;以绿色山丘、清澈湖泊和地热公园闻名;某些地方地下会喷出高高的热水;还是不会飞的小鸟几维鸟的家园;对热爱自然的人来说,新西兰是地球上最美的度假地之一。

questions.stem: Where is New Zealand located?
options: In the middle of a desert.
Far to the south of the equator.

questions.stem: What is the country famous for?
options: Its green hills, lakes and geothermal parks.

questions.stem: What happens in some geothermal areas?
options: Hot water shoots into the air.

questions.stem: What is special about the kiwi bird?
options: It is small and cannot fly.

questions.stem: Who would most enjoy New Zealand, according to the passage?

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Booking a Tour
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Good morning. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Hi, I'd like to book a tour to the famous stone castle on the hill.

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Of course. The castle was built over six hundred years ago. It's very popular.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: How long does the tour last?

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Each guided session is about two hours. Buses leave every morning at nine.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Great. Are tickets cheaper if I go during the week?

transcript.speaker: Clerk
transcript.text: Yes. Prices are lower on weekdays, away from the peak season crowds.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Then I'll take a ticket for Tuesday morning, please.

exercises.translation_cn: Tom 在旅行社想订去山上石头城堡的游览;职员说城堡有六百多年历史、很受欢迎;每场导览约两小时,巴士每天上午九点出发;工作日票价更便宜、避开旺季人群;Tom 订了周二上午的票。

questions.stem: Where does Tom want to go?
options: A stone castle on a hill.

questions.stem: How old is the castle?
How long does each guided session last?
When are tickets cheaper?
Which ticket does Tom finally choose?

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 The Story of a Tower
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The famous iron tower was first planned as a temporary structure for a great fair.
When it was proposed, many people were strongly against it.
They feared it would spoil the beauty of the city skyline.
It was meant to be taken down after twenty years, but it stayed.
Today it is loved as a proud symbol of the whole country.
exercises.translation_cn: 这座著名铁塔起初只是为一场大型博览会规划的临时建筑;提议时许多人强烈反对,担心会破坏城市天际线之美;它本打算二十年后拆除,却保留了下来;如今它被视为整个国家骄傲的象征。

questions.stem: What was the tower first planned as?
options: A temporary structure for a fair.

questions.stem: How did many people feel when it was proposed?
Why were people worried about the tower?
options: It might spoil the city skyline.

questions.stem: What was supposed to happen after twenty years?
How is the tower seen today?

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Holding a Koala
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I really want to hold a koala while I'm here. Can I do that anywhere?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Not anywhere. In many places it is against the law to touch them.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Oh, why is that? They look so gentle.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Koalas are sensitive, and too much contact can leave them stressed.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: So I can't hold one at all?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: You can, but only at certain licensed zoos run by animal experts.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I see. And the koalas there are looked after carefully?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Yes. Each one is handled for only a short time and on a limited frequency.

exercises.translation_cn: Anna 想抱考拉;导游说很多地方触摸考拉违法;因为考拉敏感,过多接触会让它们紧张;只有由动物专家经营的持证动物园才能抱;那里的考拉被精心照料,每只每次只被抱很短时间且次数有限。

questions.stem: What does Anna want to do?
Why is touching koalas often against the law?
options: Too much contact leaves them stressed.

questions.stem: Where can Anna hold a koala?
How are the koalas at those zoos treated?
options: They are handled briefly and not too often.
They are kept outside all night.
They are handled all day long.

questions.stem: What is the guide's main message?
options: Anna should never see a koala.
Holding koalas must follow strict rules.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Introduce Your City
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: When you introduce an iconic attraction in your city, start with what makes it special.
You might say it is famous for its history, its food or its beautiful views.
Explain when it was built and why people love to visit it.
Use a few lively details so your listeners can picture the place.
End with a warm invitation, telling people why the visit is worth the effort.
exercises.translation_cn: 介绍家乡的标志性景点时,先讲它的独特之处;可以说它以历史、美食或美景闻名;说明它何时建成、人们为何爱去;用一些生动细节让听众想象那个地方;最后用热情的邀请收尾,告诉大家为什么值得一去。

questions.stem: How should you begin introducing an attraction?
options: With the price of a ticket.
With a long list of dates.

questions.stem: What might you say the place is famous for?
What should you explain about the attraction?
options: When it was built and why people love it.

questions.stem: Why use lively details?
options: To make the talk longer only.
So listeners can picture the place.

questions.stem: How should you end your introduction?
